description: This Dart source file defines the AttendanceProvider class, managing attendance operations such as marking attendance, fetching attendance data, handling offline queue synchronization, and real-time updates. It interacts with various core services like API client, environment configuration, local storage, and real-time services, and maintains internal caches of attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing attendance operations, including marking attendance records, fetching attendance data, handling offline sync, and listening to real-time updates.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the provider, sets up real-time subscriptions, and attempts to drain offline queue.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels real-time subscription and cleans up resources.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks attendance for a single user/course/date with a given status; queues the action if offline.

methods.name: bulkMark
methods.description: Marks attendance for multiple users in batch; queues if the backend response is not as expected.

methods.name: fetchToday
methods.description: Fetches today's attendance records, using mock data if in mock mode.

methods.name: fetchRange
methods.description: Fetches attendance records within a date range, using cached data when offline.

methods.name: syncOfflineQueue
methods.description: Attempts to send all queued offline attendance actions to the backend.

methods.name: _handleRealtimeMessage
methods.description: Processes real-time messages related to attendance updates and updates local caches.

methods.name: _applyInboundAttendance
methods.description: Updates local caches with new or updated attendance data.

methods.name: _enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new attendance action to the offline queue.

methods.name: _formatDateKey
methods.description: Formats a DateTime into a 'yyyy-MM-dd' string used as cache keys.
